title: a test describes a TLS session with `Core\Test::tlsSession`, and an answer the table serves may report it
scope:
how a Novis program holds a non-null `Core\Http\TlsInfo` without a network: a new
member `Core\Test::tlsSession`, and a `tls` option on `Core\Test::answerHttp`. It does not change
what a real handshake reports, what `verified()` means, or the answer table's all-or-nothing switch.
